Henry’s response, "It pays the bills," serves as a pragmatic understatement, likely indicating that his current job is functional or financially stable but perhaps not his primary passion or a role he wishes to highlight prominently. By immediately steering the conversation toward industry trends, Henry demonstrates a communicative intention to shift focus from his personal professional status to broader, more neutral or intellectually engaging topics. This move allows him to maintain professionalism, avoid potential oversharing or discomfort regarding his job, and position himself as interested in the collective knowledge of the group.
